newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ex-Fed Gov Lindsey says yen near high end of range.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Fed Gov Lindsey says yen near high end of range.

text.p: Former Federal Reserve Board Governor Lawrence Lindsey said on Friday that he thinks the yen is near the high end of an appropriate range.

Asked for an appropriate level for the yen which would reflect fundamentals, Lindsey told Reuters Financial Television in an interview in Tokyo: "Of course it varies from time to time. Right now I think that we are probably near the high end of an appropriate range for the yen."
"I think that over time particularly when foreign exchange control comes off (in Japan) next April that we'll see the yen gradually weaken."
